articles.summary: Expand sanitary enclosure solutions with the new nVent HOFFMAN HyShed Sanitary Hole Seals. Designed to cover unused knockouts and pushbutton openings, these hole seals help maintain Type 4X and IP69 sealing performance while supporting the strict hygiene requirements of sanitary environments.Featuring an FDA-grade silicone gasket, HyShed Sanitary Hole Seals provide reliable protection against water ingress and help preserve enclosure integrity in demanding washdown applications.Key benefits include:
articles.title: New HyShed Sanitary Hole Seals

articles.summary: The nVent HOFFMAN IEC Electrical Interlock is equipped with a newly designed mounting bracket to support the IEC Modular Enclosure platform. The core functionality of the interlock remains untouched. When energized, the electrical interlock provides a positive internal safety lockout that prevents the door from being opened.
articles.title: Electrical Interlock Now IEC Modular-Compatible
